text: 1. Highest academic degree certificate (e.g. high school graduation certificate). If the applicant is a student, an additional proof of enrollment from the student's school must be submitted. 2. Transcript from the highest academic degree program; 3. Copy of passport; 4. Proof of Language Proficiency (Applicants for language study programs do not need to provide this); 5. Family income certificate / Deposit certificate (must cover expenses for study and living in China); 6. Two recommendation letters from associate professors or above (submit only for those applying for graduate degree programs); 7. Study and Research Plan in China. Written in Chinese or English, no less than 800 words (only applicants for postgraduate degree programs need to submit this). 8. Personal Resume (The template can be downloaded from https://sie.sdut.edu.cn/6308/); 10. Work Certificate (If you have any work experience, please provide it); 11. "Foreigner Physical Examination Form" and blood test report (available for download at https://sie.sdut.edu.cn/6308/); 12. Certificate of No Criminal Record.
